verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an issue-tracking and monitoring platform like Sentry, but nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once (such as bulk-resolving, assigning or merging issues). The cited material covers per-issue filtering, generic API resource management, MCP triage tools, automated per-issue Autofix scanning and multi-project dashboard viewing. These are adjacent features, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
